title: Wilbert Smith document naming von Neumann, Oppenheimer and Vannevar Bush on Roswell reverse-engineering team
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Wilbert Smith document naming von Neumann, Oppenheimer and Vannevar Bush on Roswell reverse-engineering team, about 1947-1950s at Roswell, New Mexico, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So he found that document, right? like saying or alleging that vonoman and per Oppenheimer I think it was >> and Vanavar Bush >> and Vanar Bush right were on the reverse engineering team for Roswell.

plain: An unnamed researcher on podcast host Jesse Michels's show says someone found a document tied to Wilbert Smith, a Canadian government engineer. According to the researcher, it claims that three top American scientists, the mathematician John von Neumann, the physicist Robert Oppenheimer and the science chief Vannevar Bush, were on a team taking apart and trying to copy, or 'reverse engineer', the craft said to have crashed near Roswell, New Mexico in 1947. If true, some of the greatest minds of the age worked on a recovered craft in secret.
